loadFailBody: The data may not be ready yet. Try again in a moment.
solving: Building the schedule from your demand, availability and limits...
solverTook: The solver took {ms} ms over {n} tries.
waitingTitle: Waiting for the owner to approve publishing
publishedNow: The schedule was published and staff were notified.
publishAsked: Sent to the owner to approve. Staff get the schedule once it is approved.
noScheduleBody: Press Propose the week: the schedule is built from your demand, then you review it before publishing.
needSetup: Add staff and the people needed per time block first (tab Staff and demand or Quick import).
explainNone: The explanation appears after you propose the week.
coverageHint: People on duty against the minimum for each time block (star = peak).
gridHintEdit: Drag a shift to another person on the same day, or tap a shift then a cell.
gridHintView: Published schedule. Changes go through swap requests.
vUnavailable: outside the hours they are free
vPosition: not able to work this position
reqNoneBody: Leave, swap and availability requests from staff appear here.
reqLeaveHint: You approve leave; an approved leave turns the person's shifts into open shifts.
reqSwapHint: Inside the rules (same position, nothing broken, enough notice) a swap is approved by itself.
reqAvailHint: Approve to apply it to the next schedules.
posHint: Roles in your shop, for example barista, waiter, cashier, stylist, mechanic.
staffHint: Each person: the positions they can work, hourly wage and limits. Link Telegram or Zalo to also get shift messages there.
staffNoneBody: Add people here or use Quick import.
covHint: For each weekday and time, how many people each position needs at least (min) and ideally (ideal). Mark busy blocks as peak.
availMgrHint: When someone cannot work, or can only work some hours. Staff can also send their own from My schedule.
rulesHint: Used by the solver, by swap approval and by reminders.
rNoShow: Alert if not checked in after (minutes)
reminderOffHint: Reminders and no-show alerts run when the automation Shift reminders is switched on (Automations).
quickHint: Type one item per line. Nothing is created until every line is right.
quickPositionsHint: One per line or separated by commas.
quickStaffHint: Name; positions; hourly wage; max hours per week. Example: An; pha chế, phục vụ; 30k; 44
quickCoverageHint: Days time position min-ideal [cao điểm]. Example: T2-T6 07:00-11:00 Pha chế 1-2
quickPreview: Will create {p} positions, {s} staff and {b} time blocks.
importDone: Created {p} positions, {s} staff and {b} time blocks.
noProfileTitle: Your account is not on the schedule yet
noProfileBody: Ask the owner to link your account to your name in Staff and demand.
mineUpcomingHint: Next 14 days. Check in when you arrive.
mineNoneBody: Your shifts appear here once the schedule is published.
checkedInOk: Checked in. Have a good shift!
openShiftsHint: Shifts nobody has yet. Ask for one; inside the rules it is yours at once.
leaveHint: Pick the days you need off. The owner approves.
availHint: Tell us when you cannot work or only some hours. The owner approves it.
availSent: Sent. The owner will approve it.
